subject.title: [Bug]: iOS-compatible app on Apple Silicon Mac registers as a phantom iPad node

question: Should an iOS build running on Apple Silicon be represented as a distinct compatibility-app device class, or should the existing iOS/iPad device metadata remain canonical with only a display-name adjustment?
rationale: Both choices affect durable operator inventory semantics and protocol-facing metadata; code inspection supports the bug report but does not establish the intended long-term taxonomy for host OS versus app runtime.

options.title: Add an explicit compatibility-app class
options.body: Publish a distinct host/runtime marker and display label while preserving the existing iOS node capability contract.

options.title: Limit the change to presentation
options.body: Keep all device metadata as iPadOS/iOS and only render a non-device display name when Apple reports the compatibility runtime.

recommendation.title: Add an explicit compatibility-app class
recommendation.body: Publish a distinct host/runtime marker and display label while preserving the existing iOS node capability contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Companion-app product direction is the closest available routing signal from the repository vision and affected app surfaces.
